Notes: Every Record is copied from a native LookupEvents match with the same exact requestID as its source Rows response. Native history was captured without creating a paid trail; the local classic management selector delivers those positive records as real S3 gzip logs.

Only a dependency-complete subset of native controls is replayed. Unique owned buckets rebind to analytics-controls; native account to ${account}; native IAM user Delegated to audit-user/${auditUserARN}. API statuses, errors, stable outputs and record field presence remain native.

Native list aliases to GetBucketAnalyticsConfiguration; GET and LIST are readOnly management events, PUT and DELETE are write management events. LookupEvent.Resources is empty for every selected call, independently of the bucket resources inside its CloudTrailEvent.

All captured analytics responseElements are null. Unlike Inventory, Analytics omits even valid PUT XML from requestParameters. Query id is absent, empty, scalar or an ordered array as submitted; continuation-token retains its literal spelling.
NoSuchConfiguration still includes the bucket resource. Positively matched NoSuchBucket records omit resources and account for zero admitted request bytes, including malformed PUT bodies.

Request/event IDs remain provenance only. Existing delivery replay rebinds event time, Host, authenticated key, error wording, request correlation and wire byte counts; native network/TLS timing fields are archive-only. No whole-document digest is asserted.

Owner-header failures and other bounded unmatched history calls are not exclusion claims. This fixture establishes management projection and local trail delivery, not native analytics CSV generation, recommendations, delivery timing or report parity.
